description: Search the Housecall Pro price book: services, material categories, materials, or price forms. For materials, pass a category_uuid (get one from kind=material_categories). Material categories NEST: the plain list returns only the roots, and materials mostly live in the child categories - pass whole_tree=true to walk every level in one call before enumerating a book. For services, include_flat_rate adds each service's recipe - its labor hours and rates and its component materials with quantities - plus computed margin where both price and cost exist.

category_uuid.description: Required when kind=materials; get it from kind=material_categories

include_flat_rate.description: services only: include each service's labor rates and component materials (the flat-rate recipe), plus margin_percent where computable

parent_uuid.description: material_categories only: list the children of this category instead of the roots. Categories nest, and materials usually live in the leaves.

query.description: Case-insensitive filter applied to names client-side

whole_tree.description: material_categories only: walk the whole nested tree and return every category with its parent_uuid and depth. Use this before enumerating a book's materials - the plain list returns only the roots.

name: hcp_search_pricebook
